## Description
Please include a summary of the change, scientific rationale, and relevant issue links.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (statistical calculation, UI capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (change that would cause existing analytics/APIs to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand statistical calculation areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally with `pytest`
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with `npm run build`
